The six moves of a frame takeover

01
Pace
Match tempo and tonality until the subject stops attending to your presence as an external object.
02
Mirror
Echo posture, gesture rhythm, and micro-expression cadence to build an unconscious baseline of sameness.
03
Test
Introduce a small, deliberate mismatch and watch for the automatic correction that reveals the bond.
04
Lead
Escalate the deviation in increments; each successful follow lowers resistance to the next.
05
Frame
Insert the new premise as an assumption, not a claim, while the other system is still following.
06
Seal
Anchor the adopted frame to a recurring phrase so it survives future context shifts.
